rewrites.//: SPA fallback: React Router owns client-side routing, so every path that is not a real file must serve index.html or a deep link 404s on refresh.

headers.//: Audit 8.1. HSTS with preload — only safe because every environment is HTTPS-only.

CSP. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required by Radix, which sets inline styles for positioning. connect-src must be widened per environment if the API is on another origin. Fonts are self-hosted precisely so font-src does not need widening; keep it that way.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.sentry.io; worker-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: Filenames are content-hashed, so they are safe to cache forever.
